shared_elements: single frontal standing anthropomorphic figure filling the field
elaborate headdress / head ornament above the face
arms bent, held out with visible hands
relief carving on a tall upright rectangular slab
dense surface ornament around the figure
justification: Both show a single large upright anthropomorphic figure occupying nearly the whole tall slab, frontally posed with elaborate headgear and bent arms holding an object, which is a real but fairly generic scheme for monumental figure stelae. The specifics differ sharply: A's human face is framed by dense curvilinear scrollwork, ornaments and small subsidiary faces with legs and feet shown below, while B shows a beaked/animal-headed figure with a large feathered wing and a bucket-like handled vessel, rendered in sparse, linear, patterned relief with a profile head on a frontal body.
